Notes_and_Tips: Keep salt intake moderate to support blood pressure control.
Avoid very oily and fried foods, especially during social gatherings.
Eat slowly and stop when comfortably full.
Regular meal timing helps manage cravings and blood pressure.
Yoga and light post-meal movement support heart health.
Focus on visible body changes and daily energy rather than quick weight loss.
